ayuda.REPORTE_INVENTARIO_BIOLOGICO: Animals and batches with their SINIGAN ID, weight, stage and value.
ayuda.REPORTE_COSTOS_SUMINISTROS: Feed, medicine and other supplies applied, with totals by type.
ayuda.REPORTE_PRODUCTIVIDAD: Production per batch and the feed conversion of the period.
ayuda.REPORTE_BAJAS_Y_SALIDAS: Deaths, sales, slaughters and transfers to another farm, with cause and value.
ayuda.REPORTE_VALORACION_NIC41: Valuation of each asset in a closed period, with the accounting export status and your signature.
ayuda.REPORTE_ESTADO_EXPORTACIONES: Accounting exports of the period, with their confirmation or errors.
ayuda.REPORTE_VARIACION_PERIODOS: Change in each asset's fair value between two closed periods.
ayuda.REPORTE_HISTORICO_SANITARIO: Health events and model predictions, with treatment and outcome.
ayuda.REPORTE_FICHA_ANIMAL: Everything about an animal or batch: ID, production, health, supplies, valuation and predictions.
ayuda.REPORTE_VACUNACION_MEDICAMENTOS: Vaccines and medicines applied and the animals still in withdrawal period.
ayuda.REPORTE_RIESGO_SANITARIO: Active risk predictions, with the 10 animals most likely at risk.
ayuda.REPORTE_TELEMETRIA: Sensor readings of an area with average, minimum and maximum.
ayuda.REPORTE_ESTADO_DISPOSITIVOS: Status of each device at a date and those with no data for over 24 hours.
ayuda.REPORTE_CALIBRACION_SENSORES: Calibrations done and sensors not calibrated in over 90 days.
ayuda.REPORTE_ALERTAS_SENSORES: Sensor alerts with duration, resolution and the devices with most alerts.
ayuda.REPORTE_EJECUTIVO_CONSOLIDADO: Business summary in five sections, totals only.
ayuda.REPORTE_RENTABILIDAD_FINCA: Inventory value against supply cost, per farm.
ayuda.REPORTE_COMPARATIVO_PERIODOS: Key indicators of two closed periods, side by side.
